visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabs that switch between sibling pages (link tabs) or between in-page panels

contentPattern.structure: One row per tab: Label | optional panel. A label that is a link with no panel navigates to that page and is active on the matching path. A panel cell that holds only a same-site link (e.g. /fragments/...) is loaded as a fragment so it can contain other blocks; any other panel content renders inline

usage: Purchase Rates / Refinance Rates switch on mortgage rate pages
reuseGuidance: Put complex panel content in a fragment and link it from the panel cell.
